name: Can I upgrade my toilet to a more water-efficient model in Henderson?

mainEntity.name: Can I upgrade my toilet to a more water-efficient model in Henderson?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can upgrade to a more water-efficient toilet model in Henderson. Many modern toilets use significantly less water per flush than older models, which can help reduce your water bill and conserve resources. When selecting a new model, look for WaterSense labeled toilets, as they meet strict EPA criteria for efficiency and performance. Consideration of the existing rough-in measurement is also important to ensure the new toilet fits your current plumbing setup without major modifications.
